name: zz-probe-mute-endpoint
description: Diagnostic: is the mute click reaching state at all, and does the user.setMuted trpc route respond? Samples aria-pressed immediately after click (before the .catch revert can run) then probes /api/trpc/user.setMuted and user.init directly to read the raw HTTP status/body.

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const before = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); b.click(); const immediate = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed'); return JSON.stringify({ before, immediateAfterClick: immediate, note: 'React may not have flushed yet' }); })()
steps.name: A - state immediately after click

steps.expression: JSON.stringify({ at2s: document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]').getAttribute('aria-pressed'), interpretation: 'if B=true and this=false, the .catch() revert fired => server call failed' })
steps.name: C - state at 2s (post-network)

steps.expression: (async () => { try { const r = await fetch('/api/trpc/user.setMuted?batch=1', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ 0: { json: { muted: true } } }) }); const t = await r.text(); return JSON.stringify({ status: r.status, ok: r.ok, body: t.slice(0, 500) }); } catch (e) { return 'FETCH THREW: ' + e.message; } })()
steps.name: D - raw POST user.setMuted

steps.expression: (async () => { try { const r = await fetch('/api/trpc/user.init?batch=1', { method: 'GET' }); const t = await r.text(); let muted = 'unparsed'; try { const j = JSON.parse(t); muted = JSON.stringify(j?.[0]?.result?.data?.json?.muted ?? j?.[0]?.result?.data?.muted ?? 'not-found'); } catch (e) {} return JSON.stringify({ status: r.status, mutedField: muted, body: t.slice(0, 400) }); } catch (e) { return 'FETCH THREW: ' + e.message; } })()
steps.name: E - read back muted via user.init

steps.expression: JSON.stringify({ consoleErrorsCaptured: (window.__testErrors || 'none - no error hook installed') })
steps.name: F - window error hook
